title: clinical behavior of monolithic multilayer zirconia ceramic restorations in the posterior region over ten years
summary:
The aim of this study is to investigate the clinical behavior of bridges and crowns made of multilayer zirconium ceramics over a period of ten years.
Data will be collected at the time of insertion and then once a year for ten years. The collected data will be compared with each other in order to evaluate the long-term stability and suitability of the materials used.
The aim of this study is to check whether the new ceramics still have stable clinical parameters after ten years.
conditions: Clinical behavior of restorations made of multilayer zirconia in the posterior region

interventions.name: Patients with crowns and bridges in the posterior region made of monolithic multilayer zirconia are examined once a year for ten years. During the examinations, clinical data and patient satisfaction are collected using study documents (mod. OHIP-G14 and CRF) and on the basis of photo documentation

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Signed declaration of consent to participate in the study, Good general health, Carrying out routine dental care
Exclusion criteria:
Bruxism or other destructive habits, Severe general diseases, Serious oral diseases, Allergies/intolerances to materials relevant to the study
